
''nice fu'ivla forms'' are those forms that don't contain VVV, CC/C or CCCC groups, which can never appear in lujvo, and start with one or two consonants. These nice forms are the ones that sit most comfortably among native Lojban forms. These forms are:

6-letter nice fu'ivla

*'''CVVC/C'''V ma'agni
*'''CCVVC'''V tce'exo

7-letter nice fu'ivla

*CVVCCVV saispai (second C different from 'r' or 'nr')
*'''CVVCCC'''V saispra (second C different from 'r' or 'nr')

*CVC/CVCV sarpasa
*CVCCCVV sasprai (VV must be a diphthong)

*CVC/CCVV sarprai
*'''CCVVC/C'''V spaipsa

*CCVCVCV spapapa

8-letter nice fu'ivla

*'''CVVC/CVC'''V paurtaki
*CVVCCCVV paustrai (final VV must be diphthong)

*CVVC/CCVV paurtra'i
*'''CVC/CVVC'''V partaika

*CVC/CVCVV partakai
*CCVVCVCV praitaki

*CCVVCCVV praitrai
*'''CCVVCCC'''V praistra

*'''CCVCVVC'''V prataiki
*CCVCVCVV pratakai

*CCVC/CVCV mlongena
*CCVCCCVV prastrai

9-letter nice fu'ivla

*'''CVVC/CVVC'''V pairtaika
*'''CVVC/CVCC'''V paintakra (second C different from 'r' or 'nr')

*'''CVVC/CCVC'''V paintraka (second C different from 'r' or 'nr')
*'''CVC/CVCVC'''V partakana

*'''CVC/CCVVC'''V partraika
*'''CCVVCVVC'''V praitaika

*CCVVCVCVV praitakai
*CCVVCVCCV praitakra

*CCVVCCCVV praistrai
*'''CCVCVVC/C'''V pratairka

*'''CCVCVCVC'''V pratakana
*'''CCVCCVVC'''V pratraika

*CCVC/CVCVV prartakai
*'''CCVC/CVCC'''V prartakra

*CCVCCVC/CV pratrarka

10-letter nice fu'ivla

*CVVC/CVVCVV painkaitai (second C different from 'r' or 'nr')
*'''CVVC/CVVCC'''V painkaitra (second C different from 'r' or 'nr')

*CVVC/CVCVCV pairkatana
*CVVC/CVCCVV painkatrai (second C different from 'r' or 'nr')

*'''CVVC/CVCCC'''V painkastra (second C different from 'r' or 'nr')
*'''CVVC/CCVVC'''V pairkraita

*CVVC/CCVCVV painkratai (second C different from 'r' or 'nr')
*'''CVVC/CCVCC'''V painkratra (second C different from 'r' or 'nr')

*CVC/CVVCVCV parkaitana
*'''CVC/CVCVVC'''V parkataina

*CVC/CVCVCVV parkatanai
*'''CVC/CVCVCC'''V parkatasna

*CVC/CVCCVCV parkatrana
*CVC/CVCCCVV parkastrai

*CVC/CCVVCVV parkraitai
*'''CVC/CCVVCC'''V parkraitra

*CVC/CCVCVCV parkratana
*CVC/CCVCCVV parkratrai

*'''CVC/CCVCCC'''V parkrastra
*'''CCVVCVVC/C'''V praikairta

*'''CCVVCVCVC'''V praikatana
*'''CCVVCCVVC'''V praikraita

*CCVVC/CVCVV prairkatai
*'''CCVVC/CVCC'''V prairlatra

*'''CCVVCCVC/C'''V praikrarta
*'''CCVVCCCVC'''V praiskrata

*CCVCVVCVCV prakaitana
*CCVCVVCCVV prakaitrai

*'''CCVCVVCCC'''V prakaistra
*'''CCVCVCVVC'''V prakataina

*CCVCVCVCVV prakatanai
*'''CCVCVCVCC'''V prakatasna

*CCVCVCCVCV prakatrana
*CCVCVCCCVV prakastrai

*'''CCVCCVVC/C'''V prakrairta
*CCVCCVCVCV prakratana

*'''CCVCCCVC/C'''V praskrarta

Forms in '''bold''' are those that can have [[rafsi fu'ivla afsi|rafsi fu'ivla afsi]].
